question: Which divine figure presides at Vṛndāvana and at Naimiṣa?
premises: Vṛndāvane names the first sacred site.
Padmapāṇiḥ is the presiding figure there.
Naimiṣe names the second sacred site.
Kuśahastas is the presiding figure there.
inference: The lotus-handed one presides at Vṛndāvana and the one with kuśa in hand presides at Naimiṣa.
plain_english: At Vṛndāvana is the lotus-handed one, and at Naimiṣa is the one with kuśa in hand.
